parts.text: How many days of paid bereavement leave am I entitled to for an immediate family member?

eval_cases.reference: Employees receive up to 5 paid bereavement leave days for an immediate family member and up to 2 paid days for an extended relative [HR-POL-LEAVE-004#3.2].

parts.text: Can I expense noise-canceling headphones under the standard travel and expense policy?

eval_cases.reference: Noise-canceling headphones are not reimbursable under standard travel & expense unless pre-approved as an ergonomic or medical accommodation [HR-POL-EXP-002#4.1].

parts.text: How many paid annual vacation and sick days do full-time employees in the Netherlands receive?

eval_cases.reference: Full-time employees in the Netherlands receive 25 paid vacation days per calendar year and up to 10 paid medical/sick days before occupational health review [POL-NL-LEAVE-2026#4.2].
